verdict.rationale: Daily's own docs say voice AI agents built with Pipecat, its open-source orchestration framework for realtime voice agents, can be deployed on Daily's infrastructure, with Pipecat Cloud as a hosted option. The docs also offer real-time Deepgram transcription. However, the evidence never spells out a session-to-pipeline integration path or names the speech-to-text → model → text-to-speech chain. Missing for 10: an explicit documented path from a live Daily session into the agent pipeline, evidence of the model and text-to-speech stages, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the vendor documents an integration path from a live session to a voice-agent pipeline of speech-to-text, a model, and text-to-speech

citations.quote: Deploy voice AI agents built with Pipecat on Daily's global infrastructure.
Pipecat is a vendor-neutral open source orchestration framework for realtime voice and multimodal AI agents.
Real-time and post-call transcription powered by Deepgram.
